question: What does acq_2 charge for a bank transfer payment, and above what amount does a refund batch need approval?
runtime: uv run --isolated --no-project --with anthropic, from a temporary folder

ava.answer:
**acq_2 bank transfer fee:** I can't tell you. Fee and SLA terms are probably in the finance knowledge base, but my query to it was refused with PERMISSION_DENIED, because I lack SELECT on `meridian.kb.idx_finance`. The general index had nothing on acq_2's bank transfer charges. I haven't guessed a figure. To get it, ask Finance or a metastore admin for access to that index.

**Refund batch approval threshold:** A refund batch needs approval when its total is above SGD 500.
- The refund policy says any batch above SGD 500 needs approval from a member of meridian-admin before it runs, and the approver must be a different person from the requester [DOC-REF-003 p.1].
- The approval runbook says the same. Batches at or below SGD 500 run without approval but are still logged [DOC-RB-021 p.1].
- The acquirer degradation runbook also makes the approval step required above SGD 500 [DOC-RB-014 p.2].

One older ops note says refunds over SGD 250 need a second approver [DOC-NOTE-250 p.1]. It is dated 2025-09-10 and conflicts with the newer policy documents (version 3 of the refund policy, effective 2026-08-26 for RB-021). I treated SGD 500 as current, but you may want to confirm that.

ben.answer:
**Bank transfer fee for acq_2:** acq_2 charges a flat SGD 0.75 per bank transfer payment [DOC-FEE-001 p.1]. That document is marked as restricted to Finance.

**Refund batch approval:** A refund batch needs approval when its total is above SGD 500. A member of meridian-admin must approve it, and the approver must be a different person from the requester [DOC-REF-003 p.1] [DOC-RB-021 p.1]. Batches at or below SGD 500 run without approval but are still logged [DOC-RB-021 p.1]. The runbook says the same thing [DOC-RB-014 p.2].

**Conflicting source:** An older ops note, DOC-NOTE-250, says refunds over SGD 250 need a second approver [DOC-NOTE-250 p.1]. It is dated 2025-09-10. The SGD 500 threshold comes from newer documents: the refund policy v3 (2026-08-31) and RB-021 (2026-08-26). I treated SGD 500 as current, but I can't confirm from the documents that the older note was formally withdrawn.
